source: Wood County joined historical criminal extracts, report years 2000–2026
screeningSnapshotLabel: Last verified workbook snapshot; live summary formulas may be in error

screeningColorDefinitions.blue: Screening timing scenario passed; not a verified eligibility finding
screeningColorDefinitions.green: Source-coded nonconviction; journal and case linkage unverified
screeningColorDefinitions.red: Possible statutory exclusion or unfinished timing period

privacy: Aggregated screening counts only. No person identifiers or criminal-history rows.
notes: Screening rows include repeated annual exports and cannot count unique people.
The source filing date, charge status, and termination date are not certified docket evidence.
Source color does not establish case-level eligibility or approval for payment or filing.
Dedupe uses case ID, defendant identity and charge information; amendments and identity changes require manual reconciliation.
